description: This file contains unit tests for the Analytics component, including mock server setup, test cases for event sending, event mapping, and plugin activation/deactivation, utilizing Google Test and Google Mock frameworks.

classes.name: ServerMock
classes.description: A mock server class that sets up a TCP socket, listens for incoming connections, receives data, and responds with HTTP status codes, used for testing event transmission.

classes.name: AnalyticsTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from L2TestMocks, setting up mock expectations and environment for testing Analytics plugin functionalities.

methods.name: AnalyticsTest()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes mock expectations, sets up environment, and activates necessary services and plugins.

methods.name: ~AnalyticsTest()
methods.description: Destructor that deactivates services, cleans up files, and verifies cleanup procedures.
